SELECT 'STG_LNS_GENERALACCTMASTFULL', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_LNS_GENERALACCTMASTFULL WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LOANS_FACT',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.LOANS_FACT GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE


SELECT * FROM EDS.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER

SELECT * FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM



INSERT OM.OM_TASK_RUN
SELECT TOP 1 TASK_RUN_ID,'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM' TASK_NAME  ,PIPELINE_RUNID,STATUS_ID,DATA_LAYER,'2023-10-03' PROCESS_DATE,START_DATETIME,END_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,TGT_RECCOUNT
 FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME='TSK_BNKM_GLD_CURRENCYCONVERSION' AND STATUS_ID=3


SELECT 
OTD.TASK_NAME,OTR.PROCESS_DATE,OTR.STATUS_ID
FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
ON OTD.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
AND PROCESS_DATE='2023-10-03'
WHERE 
DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER'
